intent: A provider-free stacked toast system (useToasts hook, toast object and the Toaster component) whose greyscale cards are dealt in, fan out on hover, swipe away, pause while read and resolve promises in place.

layout.toaster: fixed or absolute; bottom-right/left/center from 640px; full-width bottom with 16px insets on mobile; width 360px
layout.collapsed: y = -i*14px, scale = 1 - i*0.05, origin top centre; max 3 visible; back cards take the front card's height and hide their content
layout.expanded: y = -(sum of heights in front + 10px gaps), scale 1; triggered by hover, focus-within or tap
layout.demo: quiet #0a0a0b stage; one centred 460px draft card (eyebrow, title, meta with counting word count, 2x2 grid of four action cells) plus a mono hint line; the real Toaster fixed bottom-right of the viewport
layout.structure: Toaster, ToastItem, ToastGlyph; hooks useLifetime, useFocusHotkey, useTabHidden

color.approach: monochrome first; tokens in one PALETTE object as --ts-* CSS variables; theme prop dark (default) | light
color.dark: card #1c1c1f, hairline white/8%, highlight white/6%, ink #f4f4f5, muted #a1a1aa, timer white/25%, info disc #48484f/#f4f4f5, success #3ddc97/#06291a, error #ff6b5e/#3a0904
color.light: card #ffffff, hairline rgba(24,24,27,.08), ink #18181b, muted #52525b, timer rgba(24,24,27,.22), info disc #e4e4e7/#3f3f46, success #16a34a/#fff, error #dc2626/#fff
color.accent: one accent prop (default theme ink): the action button; text black or white by luminance
color.semantic: green success and red error only; info is grey

motion.easing: ease-out [0.22,1,0.36,1]; exits ease-in [0.4,0,1,1]; timings in one MOTION object
motion.enter: card rises from y 56, opacity 0, spring stiffness 380 damping 34 mass 0.9
motion.inner: 60ms apart: icon disc pops (scale 0.4->1, spring 500/35), title, description and action rise 6px out of a 4px blur over 0.34s; success check draws (pathLength 0.32s)
motion.timer: useLifetime: a life motion value 1->0 animated linearly over the remaining time, starting 0.35s after the card lands, dismissing on complete; stopped on hover, focus, drag and hidden tab, resumed from where it stopped; refilled on each update; bound to the line's scaleX
motion.promiseSettle: disc colour cross-fades, icon swaps (scale 0.4, 180ms), title cross-fades with 6px offset and 3px blur
motion.swipe: drag x, elastic 0.85, opacity fades to 0 at ±220px; past 90px or 600px/s flies 420px out over 0.22s then dismisses; else springs home 500/35
motion.demo: card rises 12px from an 8px blur (0.5s); eyebrow, title, meta 60ms apart; word count counts up 0->1,284 (0.9s); action cells from 0.24s, 60ms apart; hint at 0.5s; five toasts dealt in from 0.3s, 160ms apart, as the card lands; when the stack has been empty 1.2s (or a prop changes while it is empty) the same five are dealt again
motion.reducedMotion: no drag, no springs, 150ms fades; numbers set instantly; countdown still runs

responsive.mobile: stack spans the bottom with 16px insets; tap to expand, tap outside to collapse; demo card full width, hint drops the Alt+T clause
responsive.sm: 360px stack anchored to the chosen corner

accessibility: labelled region; Alt+T focuses the newest toast
role=status (role=alert for errors) with aria-live and a full aria-label
Esc, Delete or Backspace dismisses the focused toast
close and action buttons are real buttons with visible focus rings
timers pause on hover, focus and hidden tabs

actions: Save draft -> Draft saved: 1,284 words, all of them yours.
Publish -> Publishing to 4,120 readers… -> Published. Go and make a coffee.
Send proofs -> Couldn’t reach the printer (action: Retry now)
Move to bin -> Moved 3 drafts to the bin (action: Undo)
content.seeded: Maya Okafor left a comment (“Cut the second paragraph. Trust me.”); Cover image uploaded; Draft saved; Autosave is on; Moved 3 drafts to the bin (Undo, no description, dealt last so it sits in front)

avoid: timers that run while hovered or focused
hover-only expansion with no touch equivalent
a blue info hue or a yellow brand tile
a marketing headline or fake editor around the demo
